modules.name: Role & Designation Governance
features: Designation Mapping: Direct link between job titles and required training paths.
Auto-Enrollment Rules: Triggers training assignments based on role changes in HRIS.
Prerequisite Logic: Mandatory completion of foundational levels before advanced modules.

modules.name: Specialized NDT & Compliance
features: Certification Lifecycle: Automated tracking of validity and expiry alerts.
OJT (On-the-Job Training) Logs: Mobile-ready supervisor verification for field tasks.
Compliance Vault: Storage for medical fitness and external regulatory licenses.

modules.name: Credit Point Economy
features: Variable Weighting: Credits assigned based on duration and complexity (e.g., Workshop vs. Webinar).
Annual Targets: Credit thresholds required for performance appraisals and promotions.
External Credit Approval: Workflow for recognizing certifications from third-party bodies.

modules.name: Advanced Assessment Engine
features: Weighted Quizzing: Ability to assign importance to specific questions.
Sectional Weighting: Quiz categories (e.g., Safety, Technical, Soft Skills) with unique percentage impacts on final scores.
Question Bank Management: Categorization by difficulty and randomization.

modules.name: Analytics & Performance
features: Competency Heatmaps: Visual gaps in organizational skills based on designation.
Audit Readiness: Tamper-proof logs for regulatory inspections.
Category-wise Scorecards: Deep-dive reporting into learner strengths and weaknesses.
